Source-assisted reading of F-ypxa (Antwerpen, EHC, Fragm. 315). Every line of both faces was reread on the published images with the printed text of Hostiensis, Lectura on X 3.30.33-34 (Strasbourg 1512, vol. 2, fol. 114r) at hand. Parentheses = expanded abbreviations; square brackets = text lost at the torn edge, supplied from the print; ? = uncertain.
